posting.title: Teach an old dog new tricks [Int.Academic]

mission.posting: A potential friend of the group needs a degree added to his resume'

email.subject: Binary Universe(ity)
email.body:
It's good to have friends in high places in digital security companies - *especially* friends that know nothing about computer security. One such very friendly individual has recently been contacted by an agent, and we need a small show of power to win him over.
We'd like you to give him a new degree, from his local university in Manchester.
Name: John Stalvern Degree: "Masters in Digital Security" University: "Manchester University" GPA: 3.0 or higher
IMPORTANT: Remember to clear your tracks - international institutes rely on their reputation to remain relevant - you are compromising that. If they discover this, they will not be forgiving.
Good luck, -CSEC
